title: Latin & Ancient Greek dictionary: Wiktionary-derived edition
description:
Version 0.1.0-beta.1 (beta): a fixed English Wiktionary-derived Latin and Ancient Greek dictionary by Classical Cat DH Lab, with source-qualified corrections and a finite offline word-form index. This record archives the actual portable SQLite data, static reader, original input slices, admitted source witnesses, software source and checksums. Frontend presentation remains provisional.

Derived data and data documentation: CC BY-SA 4.0, preserving Wiktionary contributor credit and separately credited quotations. Original software: AGPL-3.0-only; fonts retain their own licences. Independent edition, not endorsed by Wikimedia. See the included licence map and NOTICE.
